metadata.title: Tri Tue Viet Tutoring Centre — 1-on-1, small group and online
metadata.description: Tri Tue Viet tutors students from grade 1 to 12 across every school subject and programming — personalised learning paths, dedicated teachers, clear progress reports.

hero.title: A learning path that fits, with progress you can see
hero.subtitle: Tri Tue Viet builds an individual plan for every student — entry assessment, the right class, and regular progress reports for parents.

courses.title: Courses by subject and grade
courses.description: Open to students from grade 1 to 12 across every school subject, plus programming courses from first steps to competitive and career tracks.

items.name: Natural sciences
items.description: Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Biology and General Science — aligned with the national curriculum, the grade 10 entrance exam and the graduation exam.

items.name: Social sciences
items.description: Literature, History, Geography and Civics — reading comprehension, argumentative writing and exam technique for the current format.

items.name: Foreign languages
items.description: English from the ground up through to exam skills; other languages arranged on request.

items.name: Programming basics
items.description: Algorithmic thinking and a first programming language, starting from zero at each student's own pace.

items.name: Competitive programming
items.description: Algorithms and data structures for informatics olympiad candidates and programming contests.

items.name: Programming for work
items.description: A path for people already working or moving into software, structured around the job they are aiming for.

formats.title: Pick the format that suits your child
formats.description: Four formats, the same teacher quality and the same progress reporting.

items.name: One-on-one
items.description: The teacher focuses entirely on one student and adjusts pace lesson by lesson.

items.name: Small group of 3 – 6
items.description: More affordable, still closely supervised, with peer motivation added.

items.name: Online classes
items.description: Live lessons with recordings, suited to distance or a busy schedule.

items.name: Home tutoring
items.description: The teacher comes to your home on a schedule you set.

process.title: Four steps to your child's first lesson
process.description: Nothing is charged until you are happy with the trial lesson.

steps.title: Free consultation
steps.description: Leave your details and we call back within 24 hours to hear about your child's goals.

steps.title: Entry assessment
steps.description: A short test pinpoints the actual knowledge gaps — no placement by guesswork.

steps.title: Class and teacher matching
steps.description: We match your child to the teacher and format that fit the assessment result.

steps.title: Trial lesson and tracking
steps.description: A free trial lesson, then regular progress reports sent to parents.

teachers.title: The teachers your child will work with
teachers.description: Every teacher passes a subject interview and a trial lesson before taking a class.

achievements.title: Student achievements
achievements.description: These figures are updated each academic year.

pricing.title: Transparent tuition, no hidden extras
pricing.description: Tuition is charged per session and per format. The first trial lesson is free.
pricing.note: Tuition varies by grade and by the number of sessions booked. Contact us for an exact quote.

items.question: Is the trial lesson charged?
items.answer: No. The first trial lesson is free; you only pay once you decide to enrol.

items.question: Can a struggling student keep up in a group class?
items.answer: The entry assessment places your child at the right level. If the gap is still large we recommend one-on-one lessons for the first stage.

items.question: How is progress reported?
items.answer: Parents receive regular reports covering homework completion, test scores and the teacher's comments.

items.question: Can we change teacher if it is not a good fit?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us and we will arrange a different teacher at no extra cost.

items.question: Which platform do online classes use?
items.answer: Online classes run live and are recorded so your child can review them during the week.

items.question: Is tuition paid monthly or per course?
items.answer: Either. Paying per course usually comes with a better rate.

contact.description: Leave your details and we will call back within 24 working hours.
